title: Hello, Manim!
description: This is pretty premitive: the greeting and 1 + 1 = 2 fade in together, then hold. This checks text, LaTeX and video playback; it is a placeholder, not a finished mathematical film.

title: Huffman encoding
description: Build a Huffman tree from a sentence, trace its codes, and count the complete file. A short message grows when the tree is included; a longer constructed sample shows how skew and overhead change the result.
